\section[(dialogue)]{Nature, animals and describing words — a first pass}

\label{lesson:GE-R103-first-pass-nature-animals-and-describing-words}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a journey and a holiday.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a spoon, a bottle, an exercise book, a pen, paper
  \item a school, a card; a map; a ticket, a picture, a bag; a pocket, money
  \item a telephone, a tree, a flower, a leaf; a sheet of paper, a mountain
  \item a forest, a stone, an island, a field, the sky; heaven
  \item a star, a cloud, rain, a pond, fire
  \item ice; ice cream, a hill, a desert, a horse, a cow
  \item a pig, a bird, a mouse, a fox, a snake; a queue
  \item a duck, a sheep, a goat, a lion, a monkey
  \item a bee, an ant, an elephant, to fetch, to wish
  \item small, short, fast, slow, light; easy
  \item heavy; difficult, cheap, high, low, empty
  \item strong, weak, rich, ugly, sweet
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A spoon? (\textbf{der Löffel}.) A bottle? (\textbf{die Flasche}.) An exercise book? (\textbf{das Heft}.) A pen? (\textbf{der Stift}.) Paper? (\textbf{das Papier}.) A school? (\textbf{die Schule}.) A card; a map; a ticket? (\textbf{die Karte}.) A picture? (\textbf{das Bild}.) A bag; a pocket? (\textbf{die Tasche}.) Money? (\textbf{das Geld}.) A telephone? (\textbf{das Telefon}.) A tree? (\textbf{der Baum}.) A flower? (\textbf{die Blume}.) A leaf; a sheet of paper? (\textbf{das Blatt}.) A mountain? (\textbf{der Berg}.) A forest? (\textbf{der Wald}.) A stone? (\textbf{der Stein}.) An island? (\textbf{die Insel}.) A field? (\textbf{das Feld}.) The sky; heaven? (\textbf{der Himmel}.) A star? (\textbf{der Stern}.) A cloud? (\textbf{die Wolke}.) Rain? (\textbf{der Regen}.) A pond? (\textbf{der Teich}.) Fire? (\textbf{das Feuer}.) Ice; ice cream? (\textbf{das Eis}.) A hill? (\textbf{der Hügel}.) A desert? (\textbf{die Wüste}.) A horse? (\textbf{das Pferd}.) A cow? (\textbf{die Kuh}.) A pig? (\textbf{das Schwein}.) A bird? (\textbf{der Vogel}.) A mouse? (\textbf{die Maus}.) A fox? (\textbf{der Fuchs}.) A snake; a queue? (\textbf{die Schlange}.) A duck? (\textbf{die Ente}.) A sheep? (\textbf{das Schaf}.) A goat? (\textbf{die Ziege}.) A lion? (\textbf{der Löwe}.) A monkey? (\textbf{der Affe}.) A bee? (\textbf{die Biene}.) An ant? (\textbf{die Ameise}.) An elephant? (\textbf{der Elefant}.) To fetch? (\textbf{holen}.) To wish? (\textbf{wünschen}.) Small? (\textbf{klein}.) Short? (\textbf{kurz}.) Fast? (\textbf{schnell}.) Slow? (\textbf{langsam}.) Light; easy? (\textbf{leicht}.) Heavy; difficult? (\textbf{schwer}.) Cheap? (\textbf{billig}.) High? (\textbf{hoch}.) Low? (\textbf{niedrig}.) Empty? (\textbf{leer}.) Strong? (\textbf{stark}.) Weak? (\textbf{schwach}.) Rich? (\textbf{reich}.) Ugly? (\textbf{hässlich}.) Sweet? (\textbf{süß}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Town, clothes, numbers and more — a second pass}

\label{lesson:GE-R103-second-pass-town-clothes-numbers-and-more}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for clean and dirty.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item clean, dirty, thick; fat, thin, quiet
  \item right, wrong, important, simple, brown
  \item grey, purple, a second, always, immediately
  \item today, sometimes, there, far, on the right
  \item a shop, a market, a railway station, an aeroplane, a car
  \item a bridge, a church, a pharmacy, a village, the police
  \item a library, a bicycle, a bus or tram stop, clothes, a shirt
  \item a dress, trousers, a shoe, a cap, a sock
  \item a belt, a jacket, a border, the world, a language
  \item thirty, forty, fifty, a hundred, a thousand
  \item zero, a word, an answer, work, music
  \item a song, a game, a colour, a journey, a holiday
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Clean? (\textbf{sauber}.) Dirty? (\textbf{schmutzig}.) Thick; fat? (\textbf{dick}.) Thin? (\textbf{dünn}.) Quiet? (\textbf{leise}.) Right? (\textbf{richtig}.) Wrong? (\textbf{falsch}.) Important? (\textbf{wichtig}.) Simple? (\textbf{einfach}.) Brown? (\textbf{braun}.) Grey? (\textbf{grau}.) Purple? (\textbf{lila}.) A second? (\textbf{die Sekunde}.) Always? (\textbf{immer}.) Immediately? (\textbf{sofort}.) Today? (\textbf{heute}.) Sometimes? (\textbf{manchmal}.) There? (\textbf{dort}.) Far? (\textbf{weit}.) On the right? (\textbf{rechts}.) A shop? (\textbf{der Laden}.) A market? (\textbf{der Markt}.) A railway station? (\textbf{der Bahnhof}.) An aeroplane? (\textbf{das Flugzeug}.) A car? (\textbf{das Auto}.) A bridge? (\textbf{die Brücke}.) A church? (\textbf{die Kirche}.) A pharmacy? (\textbf{die Apotheke}.) A village? (\textbf{das Dorf}.) The police? (\textbf{die Polizei}.) A library? (\textbf{die Bibliothek}.) A bicycle? (\textbf{das Fahrrad}.) A bus or tram stop? (\textbf{die Haltestelle}.) Clothes? (\textbf{die Kleidung}.) A shirt? (\textbf{das Hemd}.) A dress? (\textbf{das Kleid}.) Trousers? (\textbf{die Hose}.) A shoe? (\textbf{der Schuh}.) A cap? (\textbf{die Mütze}.) A sock? (\textbf{die Socke}.) A belt? (\textbf{der Gürtel}.) A jacket? (\textbf{die Jacke}.) A border? (\textbf{die Grenze}.) The world? (\textbf{die Welt}.) A language? (\textbf{die Sprache}.) Thirty? (\textbf{dreißig}.) Forty? (\textbf{vierzig}.) Fifty? (\textbf{fünfzig}.) A hundred? (\textbf{hundert}.) A thousand? (\textbf{tausend}.) Zero? (\textbf{null}.) A word? (\textbf{das Wort}.) An answer? (\textbf{die Antwort}.) Work? (\textbf{die Arbeit}.) Music? (\textbf{die Musik}.) A song? (\textbf{das Lied}.) A game? (\textbf{das Spiel}.) A colour? (\textbf{die Farbe}.) A journey? (\textbf{die Reise}.) A holiday? (\textbf{der Urlaub}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
